description: A project's terms and claims put on other sites (PM-1165–PM-1168), and its sets: for each, its id, 'kind' (term, claim or set), 'name' (the term's word, the claim's label, the set's name), the ready code — 'script' (the cloud's script, once per page), 'mark' (the words on the site that open the cloud) and, for one thing, 'iframe' (a card) and 'url' — the sites allowed to show it (empty is any), the term ('expiresAt', null until removed), who made it and when, and how many times it was opened. A set lists what it names in 'items'; a term on it you may not open is only counted in 'hidden'. Only for somebody who may write in the project.
name: list_registry_embeds
title: List registry embeds
